source.title: Annual Report of the Director of the Geophysical Laboratory, 1988-1989
source.section_title: The Effect of Pressure, Temperature, and Composition on the Lattice Parameters and Density of (Fe,Mg)SiO3-Perovskites to 30 GPa
source.publisher: Geophysical Laboratory, Carnegie Institution of Washington

transcription.scope: All room-temperature rows printed in Table 8; the separate high-temperature Table 9 was not transcribed because it is not input to the audited 298 K BM2 records.
transcription.pressure_uncertainty: The report says the gold- and ruby-scale pressures were averaged and had a 0.2 GPa standard deviation. The repeated CSV value records that source statement; it is not an independently estimated per-row weight.
transcription.exclusions: None stated. The report says the three complete composition sets were combined.
transcription.weights: No weights are stated. Near-exact coefficient recovery from the rounded table is obtained with unweighted pressure residuals.

relation_to_final_publication.relationship: Authoritative pre-publication report of the same experiment and nearly identical title, but not the final journal article.
relation_to_final_publication.material_difference: The precursor combines all three compositions and reports K0=273.4(2.4) GPa for the fixed-K0-prime Birch fit. The final article instead fits nine Fe10 room-temperature rows, including four additional D-series runs, using Anderson et al. (1989) gold pressures and reports K0=261(4) GPa with K0-prime fixed at 4.
relation_to_final_publication.disposition: Diagnostic precursor observations only. The separately bundled final-article Tables 2-3 dataset is the fit resource for the production EOS records.
